attempts.reasoning:
Build standard BSS sets. Gholdengo: Choice Scarf? Item clause—give Garchomp Choice Scarf, Gholdengo Life Orb Nasty Plot. Dragonite Dragoninite? Mega Dragonite exists in Champions (Dragoninite). Mega Dragonite is strong. Use it.

Sets:
- Gholdengo @ Life Orb, Nasty Plot, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, Recover/Focus Blast.
- Dragonite @ Dragoninite, Dragon Dance, Extreme Speed, Earthquake, Roost (or Ice Spinner).
- Garchomp @ Choice Scarf, Earthquake, Outrage, Rock Slide, Poison Jab.
- Rotom-Wash @ Leftovers, Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Will-O-Wisp, Protect.
- Kingambit @ Black Glasses, Swords Dance, Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Iron Head.
- Annihilape @ Sitrus Berry, Bulk Up, Rage Fist, Drain Punch, Taunt.

Items are all unique per Item Clause, and EVs max the key offensive/speed stats with small defensive leftovers.
